ways.label: Full Whanganui Journey, Taumarunui to Pipiriki
evidence: The full Whanganui Journey is 145 km, from Taumarunui to Pipiriki.
Start at Ngāhuinga (Cherry Grove) Domain, off Cherry Grove Road in Taumarunui.
The Whanganui Journey ends at Pipiriki village.

ways.label: Shorter version, Whakahoro to Pipiriki
evidence: A popular shorter version is 88 km, from Whakahoro to Pipiriki.
Whakahoro is the last road access point before the end of the Whanganui Journey at Pipiriki. Many people start their trip here.

access_points.name: Ohinepane Campsite
access_points.quote: Ohinepane Campsite, accessed from Whanganui River Road (State Highway 43).

side_trips.name: Ōhura Falls
side_trips.quote: Take a short trip up the Ōhura River to see the Ōhura Falls.

not_on_route.name: Puketotara Hut
not_on_route.quote: There is alternative hut accommodation at Puketotara Hut on the Matemateaonga Range, a 1 hour 30 min hike up a track opposite Tīeke Kāinga.

not_on_route.name: Tamatea's Cave
not_on_route.quote: Do not enter the cave as it is wāhi tapu (a sacred place).

doubts: This is a canoe trip down the Whanganui River, not a walk; the way is the river, which has no entry in names or links. The start is Ngāhuinga (Cherry Grove) Domain in Taumarunui; there are no road end features, so the start ref is the Taumarunui place entry (T18), not the domain itself. Times 'an average of 5 days' and 'an average of 3 days' come from the trip length list, not a 'Time:' heading. The Whakahoro start of the shorter version could be the Whakahoro place (T23) or Whakahoro Campsite (L4); the place was given. The Whakahoro Bunkroom is named as accommodation but has no link. Puketotara Hut is alternative accommodation reached by a 1 hr 30 min track and is not on the river. Businesses' 1- and 2-day trips and jet boat trips are not recorded as ways because the page gives no start or end for them.
